'''Garak Los''' was a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he was shipping [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] ambushed his crew and stole the converters.
